description: The figure contains two multi-level donut (sunburst-style) pie charts comparing how documents are distributed across topical categories for two methods, labeled “AttentionInfluence” (left) and “FineWeb-Edu Classifier” (right), with an inner ring of broad domains and an outer ring of subcategories; each chart shows 4 inner slices and 14 outer slices (18 total categories per chart). In the AttentionInfluence chart, the inner ring consists of Education 25 (teal/green), Health & Medicine 22 (blue), Science 15 (red), and History & Society 23 (orange); the outer ring breaks these into Teaching & resources 15 (teal), Science & technology education 10 (teal), Diseases 11 (blue), Medical 6 (blue), Nutrition 5 (blue), Animal & Plant 13 (red), Materials 2 (red), Historical review 7 (orange), Society & culture 10 (orange), Events & people 6 (orange), Infor tech 5 (brownish), Materials 3 (brownish), Emerging tech 4 (brownish), Manage 2 (cyan), Policy 1 (cyan), and Fin & Law 3 (cyan). In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, the inner ring consists of Education 38 (teal/green), Health & Medicine 19 (blue), Science 15 (red), and History & Society 19 (orange); the outer ring shows Teaching & resources 17 (teal), Science & technology education 19 (teal), Healthy education 2 (light teal), Diseases 10 (blue), Nutrition 7 (blue), Medical 2 (blue), Animal & Plant 12 (red), Materials 3 (red), Historical review 12 (orange), Society & culture 5 (orange), Infor tech 3 (brownish), Materials 1 (brownish), Emerging tech 4 (brownish), Manage 1 (cyan), and a small “Tech & Engineer” slice labeled 8 (brownish). Both charts place numeric labels directly on slices (as counts rather than percent signs), use consistent color families by domain, include no separate legend, and visually emphasize some wedges via slight separation/offset (notably the orange “History & Society” region on the left and the red “Science” region on the right); the slices appear arranged around the circle by domain group rather than strictly ordered by size.
